tonight.headline: Rice and Barkley are ruled out; your lineup is still the projection lineup
body: Bad news first: Rashee Rice and Saquon Barkley were both ruled out on Friday's reports, and Jacksonville's Week 7 bye takes Lawrence, your only quarterback, with Tuten and Strange. You dropped Alvin Kamara for Josh Jacobs at 20:52 UTC; Jacobs is reinstated Monday and cannot play Sunday — he is a Week 7 move.

This week: 119.6 projected as set, which is the projection lineup, against 85.9. You trail 0 to 5.2 only because Emanuel Wilson played Thursday. Los Cachanillas still start Jalen Hurts (ruled out) at quarterback with Kirk Cousins on their bench, and the Vikings' defence, on bye.

case.label: Why it can tighten
case.body: Cousins into their quarterback slot adds about 17, and any defence about 7: their ceiling is near 110.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing on your side: no starter carries a tag.

waiverAnalysis.summary: The tool now flags eight risers because its weakest movable back is Josh Jacobs, added today with zero opportunities — an exempt-list artifact, not a role.
